literal.prompt: Как называется деталь с внутренней резьбой, которую навинчивают на болт?

grounds: Internal receiving thread and being screwed onto a bolt isolate nut among these four. Bolt and screw have external threaded bodies; a rivet does not receive the bolt in an internal thread. FAQ overlap of bolt/screw labels does not create another correct choice here.

sources.context: Nylok pellet paragraph and figure 4; contrasted with deformed-thread fig.3, collar fig.5, castellated fig.6 and Nylok footnote 8.
Q10/A10 entire page: four proposed bolt/screw distinctions, none universally acceptable, final instruction to specify geometry or part number.

literal: У гайки внутренняя резьба, в которую навинчивается наружная резьба болта. Некоторые гайки имеют стопорный элемент, который добавляет сопротивление отвинчиванию.
grounds: RP fig.3/4/5 show the internal female thread receiving the bolt and different locking mechanisms. Некоторые is correctly limited: locknuts are a subtype, not all nuts. Resistance to unscrewing is the stated locking function.

sources.context: Nylok pellet paragraph and figure 4; contrasted with deformed-thread fig.3, collar fig.5, castellated fig.6 and Nylok footnote 8.

literal: Заклёпки устанавливают постоянно; для удаления обычно приходится высверливать крепёж.
grounds: RP p.30 explicitly treats rivets as permanent fasteners and drilling as removal. The Russian usually is weaker than the manual categorical wording and does not claim drilling is the only conceivable operation. Adds the practical cost of dismantling: drilling out the fastener; this is absent from the head-forming question and is more than a reworded definition.

sources.context: Rivets: permanent installation and drilling removal; Solid rivets shop head, Table IX including reference 21 and Briles footnote 13.

literal: Большинство болтов изготавливают из углеродистой, легированной или нержавеющей стали.
grounds: RP p.5 explicitly says most bolts are carbon, alloy or stainless steel. Большинство preserves the qualifier and allows titanium/aluminium exceptions; the card makes no unsupported strength/corrosion claim. Adds material selection information rather than repeating the question or an external-thread definition.

sources.context: Fastener Materials, first paragraph; page read through Cadmium Plating and numbered precautions.

literal: Нейлоновый вкладыш выступает в резьбу; сопряжённая резьба сжимает его и создаёт стопорящий контакт.
grounds: RP p.11 Nylok paragraph and fig.4 support projection, mating-thread compression and locking contact. This is a statement about a named nylon insert, not an assertion that every nut contains it. Nut-card explanation explicitly says Некоторые гайки; rivet-card note likewise has no universal quantifier. More explicit subtype wording would improve standalone clarity but the actual sentence does not claim all nuts have nylon. Explains how one locking element works, beyond the internal-thread definition; a player learns a real mechanical effect.

sources.context: Nylok pellet paragraph and figure 4; contrasted with deformed-thread fig.3, collar fig.5, castellated fig.6 and Nylok footnote 8.

literal: Граница между винтом и болтом не универсальна: NASA советует указывать геометрию или номер детали.
grounds: FAQ p.383 explicitly rejects a universally acceptable distinction and concludes with geometry or corresponding part number. NASA is the publishing organisation; the card accurately attributes its advice without turning a local distinction into an absolute rule. Warns why a label alone is insufficient for selecting a part and names two practical alternatives. It does not simply repeat the screw definition.

sources.context: Q10/A10 entire page: four proposed bolt/screw distinctions, none universally acceptable, final instruction to specify geometry or part number.

literal.prompt: Какой крепёж устанавливают в отверстие и расклёпывают с выступающей стороны, формируя замыкающую головку?

grounds: The described upset/formed closing head is rivet installation. Merely having a hole does not suffice: bolt, screw and nut are normally tightened by thread engagement, not set by upsetting their protruding end. The stem describes a class instance and does not assert every blind rivet is hammer-bucked.

sources.context: Rivets: permanent installation and drilling removal; Solid rivets shop head, Table IX including reference 21 and Briles footnote 13.
Fig.34 head types, fig.35, fig.36 setting sequence and Tubular rivets final paragraph describing hollow end formed into field head.

literal: При установке заклёпки выступающий конец формируют в замыкающую головку. Такое соединение постоянно; для обычного удаления заклёпку высверливают.
grounds: RP p.30 solid-rivet paragraph and p.31 tubular-rivet paragraph support forming the protruding end into a shop/field head. RP p.30 supports permanent setting and drilling for removal. Nothing says every rivet design uses identical installation tools.

sources.context: Rivets: permanent installation and drilling removal; Solid rivets shop head, Table IX including reference 21 and Briles footnote 13.
Fig.34 head types, fig.35, fig.36 setting sequence and Tubular rivets final paragraph describing hollow end formed into field head.
